system_prompt: You are taking a test on your knowledge of the chemical composition of mushrooms. Answer strictly in JSON using exactly these keys: {"mushroom": "...", "composition": [{"compound": "...", "amount": "...", "effect": "..."}]}. In "amount" give a number with a unit (% of fresh weight, % of dry weight, mg/kg, mg/g, or per fruiting body) — if you do not know, write "unknown". In "effect" give one short sentence about the compound's effect on humans. List the main chemical compounds of this mushroom. Answer in English. No text outside the JSON.
